'''Mukarram Hussain Khundkar''' ({{circa|1922}} – 30 November 1972) was a Bangladeshi scientist and educationist.<ref name=lights>{{Cite news|url=https://www.thedailystar.net/news-detail-136957|title=Prof M. H. Khundkar|date=2010-05-04|work=The Daily Star|author=Maliha Afrin|access-date=2018-08-05|language=en}}</ref> He served as a professor at the Department of Chemistry of the [[University of Dhaka]]. He was one of the founding fellows of the [[Bangladesh Academy of Sciences]].<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.bas.org.bd/component/content/article/34-general/56-list-of-fellows.html|title=List of Fellows|work=Bangladesh Academy of Sciences|access-date=2018-08-04}}</ref>

==Biography==
Khundkar passed the matriculation examination from Barisal Zilla School and intermediate from [[Jagannath College]].<ref name=lights/> He completed his bachelor's and master's degrees in chemistry at the [[University of Dhaka]] and became a lecturer there in 1944.<ref name=lights/> In 1945, he went to England on a government scholarship.<ref name="Khan1970">{{cite encyclopedia |editor-last=Khan |editor-first=Khan Tahawar Ali |encyclopedia=Biographical Encyclopedia of Pakistan |title=Mukarram Hussain Khundkar |edition=1969-70 |year=1970 |location=Lahore |publisher=Biographical Research Institute, Pakistan |oclc=01774840 |page=101}}</ref> He earned his Ph.D. in chemistry from the [[University of Durham]].<ref name=bpedia>{{cite book |last=Islam |first=Sirajul |year=2012 |editor1-last=Islam |editor1-first=Sirajul |editor1-link=Sirajul Islam |title=Banglapedia: National Encyclopedia of Bangladesh |edition=Second |publisher=[[Asiatic Society of Bangladesh]]|chapter=Khundkar, Mukarram Hussain|chapter-url=https://en.banglapedia.org/index.php?title=Khundkar,_Mukarram_Hussain |editor2-first=Md|editor2-last=Murshed}}</ref>

Khundkar became a [[Reader (academic rank)|reader]] in the chemistry department of the University of Dhaka in 1949.<ref name=lights/> He became the head of the department in 1954. The same year, he was elected a Fellow of the [[Royal Institute of Chemistry]] (FRIC) of Great Britain and a [[Fellow of the Royal Society of Arts]] (FRSA), London. He was elected a Fellow of the [[Pakistan Academy of Sciences]] in 1959. He was promoted to professor in 1960.<ref name="Khan1970" /> His contributions to various fields of chemistry included modification of cellulose and jute, electrochemistry, metal sulphides, non-metallic sulphur compounds, inorganic borates, organo-boron compounds, mineral processing, and analytical chemistry.

Khundkar was a member of the sub-committee for Science and Technology of the [[Bangla Academy (Bangladesh)|Bangla Academy]] and chairman of the Paribhasa Committee for Chemistry of the Central Board for the development of [[Bengali language|Bengali]].<ref name=lights/>

==Awards==
* Pakistan Academy of Sciences Gold Medal for research in the physical sciences{{fact|date=July 2024}}
* University Gold Medal of Dhaka University<ref name=lights/>
* [[Independence Day Award]] (1977)<ref name=indepen>{{cite web|url=https://brri.portal.gov.bd/sites/default/files/files/brri.portal.gov.bd/page/87944ec4_496e_415d_af37_27a10fb35625/Independence%20Day%20Award.pdf|title=Independence Day Award|access-date=23 September 2016|publisher=Government of Bangladesh}}</ref>

==Legacy==
University of Dhaka holds a memorial lecture every year named ''Khundkar Memorial Lecture'' in his memory.<ref name=edu>{{cite web |url=http://www.univdhaka.edu/department/index.php?bodyid=CHM|title=Department of Chemistry|access-date=2008-03-11 |publisher=[[University of Dhaka]] |archive-url = https://web.archive.org/web/20080212115906/http://www.univdhaka.edu/department/index.php?bodyid=CHM <!-- Bot retrieved archive --> |archive-date = 2008-02-12}}</ref> A science building of the university is named as ''Mukarram Hussain Biggyan Bhaban''. One of the main buildings of the [[Bangladesh Council of Scientific and Industrial Research]] (BCSIR) is named as ''Khundkar Smriti Bhaban''. The university also hosts a research chair in memory of him.<ref>{{cite news |title= Research chairs at DU out of use |url=http://www.newagebd.com/2007/apr/21/nat.html |newspaper=The New Age |agency=bdnews24.com |date= 2007-04-21 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20080404001820/http://www.newagebd.com/2007/apr/21/nat.html |archive-date=2008-04-04 |access-date=2008-03-11}}</ref>
